stem.text: A sound wave is detected by a microphone. The output from the microphone is connected to the Y-input of a cathode-ray oscilloscope (c.r.o.). The trace on the c.r.o. is shown.

stem.alt: Trace on a cathode-ray oscilloscope screen: a sine-shaped waveform on a square grid.

stem.text: The time-base is set at $0.20\,\text{ms}$ per division.
What is the frequency of the sound wave?
